name: Retro Editorial
tagline: A tiled wall that re-tiles itself: heritage packaging, stamps and engraved ink.
description: Warm heritage editorial: a teal tiled wall with dark grout is the permanent set, and every scene change re-tiles it tile by tile in a scattered mosaic. Cream paper, brick red, sand and navy ink; perforated stamps, engraved illustration, a soft serif wordmark with spaced small caps; objects drift slowly with soft contact shadows.

signature: mosaic re-tile: the wall changes colour tile by tile in a scattered, clustered order (~2 frames per tile), never a cut
deck fan: stamps slide out from under each other like cards and gather back
slow drift in 3/4 view with soft contact shadows while the wall re-tiles behind

camera: Almost still: a locked frontal view of the wall with objects drifting a few pixels and degrees; occasional top-down flat lay. Never handheld, never fast.

texture.notes: Glazed ceramic tiles with slight per-tile tone variation and a soft sheen, dark grout lines, paper fibre on stamps, engraved line illustration, a warm vignette.

lighting: Soft warm daylight from the upper left, long gentle contact shadows under paper and tins, a faint sheen across the glaze.
sound: Warm and analogue: soft tile clicks in clusters as the wall re-tiles, paper slides and stamp thuds, a light acoustic or bossa bed, room tone.

motionSummary: Moves like a slow shop window: the tiled wall re-tiles itself tile by tile into each new scene while stamps drift, fan out like a deck and gather back.

composition: the tiled wall is always the set; scenes are colour-block layouts snapped to whole tiles
one hero object (stamp, tin, label) on a third in 3/4 or slight rotation, the wordmark on the opposite side
small spaced-caps folios in the corners; generous wall around everything
visual.shapeLanguage: square tiles with dark grout, perforated stamp edges, oval and rectangular frames with double rules, engraved line work, guilloche rosettes
visual.contrast: warm and medium: teal, brick red and sand fields with cream paper and navy ink; contrast comes from paper on wall, not light

grammar.pacing: unhurried: scenes of 3–6 s, one change at a time, holds long enough to read a label twice
grammar.rhythm: smooth drift on ones, punctuated by the wall's clustered tile-by-tile re-tiling (quantised to 2 f per tile)
grammar.easing: ease-out enters, gentle ease-in exits, heavy damped springs (paper, stamp); no overshoot, no snap
grammar.acceleration: everything starts and stops softly over 0.5–1 s; the only quick thing is a single tile flipping
movement: mosaic re-tile of the wall in scattered clusters
slow 3/4 drift and ±2° rotation of the hero object
stamps fanning out from under each other and gathering
wordmark rising letter by letter out of a baseline mask
top-down flat lay: a tin lid lifts
grammar.density: low: the wall (changing in clusters) plus 1–3 paper objects; never more than one object moving fast
grammar.holds: long: the drift never stops but the composition holds 1.5–3 s after each re-tile

transitionPresets.name: Mosaic re-tile
transitionPresets.build: each tile switches to the next scene's colour (or image) on its own frame, quantised to 2 f, in 2×2-ish clusters spreading from a corner with scatter; ~20 % of tiles pass through sand for 4 f; 22–26 f per wipe

transitionPresets.name: Deck fan
transitionPresets.build: two or three stamps slide out from under the hero like a fanned deck (offset and rotate 4–9°), each 4 f behind the last, with soft shadows; reversed, they gather back under it
transitionPresets.sound: paper slides, a soft thud as the deck settles

transitionPresets.name: Drift through
transitionPresets.build: the object keeps drifting (a few px and degrees) at constant speed while the wall re-tiles behind it, so the scene changes without the subject stopping
transitionPresets.sound: room tone, the click clusters behind

transitionPresets.name: Printed match cut
transitionPresets.bridge: a shape printed in both scenes (oval, stamp frame, tile, pattern ribbon)
transitionPresets.build: cut (or re-tile) on the frame where the shared shape sits in the same place: a stamp's oval frame becomes a tin label's oval, a tile becomes a stamp

transitionPresets.name: Into the engraving
transitionPresets.build: a slow push into the engraving until its line work fills the frame and its ink colour becomes the next tile colour; use once per film at most

archetypes.name: Hero on the wall
archetypes.purpose: introduce the product as a crafted object
archetypes.composition: teal wall, one stamp or tin on a third in 3/4 with a soft contact shadow, a folio in small caps
archetypes.elements: hero object, engraved illustration, perforations, folio
archetypes.motion: slow drift and ±2° rotation over the whole shot

archetypes.name: Colour-block field
archetypes.composition: the wall re-tiled into a colour-block layout (red field with a sand column, a sand block behind the hero), snapped to whole tiles
archetypes.elements: tiles, the hero carried across, a spaced-caps line
archetypes.motion: the re-tile itself, then a hold; the hero drifts through

archetypes.name: Stamp deck
archetypes.composition: three stamps fanned from one point, each a variant, on a colour field
archetypes.elements: stamps with numerals and engraving, shadows
archetypes.motion: fan out 4 f apart, hold, gather back
archetypes.camera: locked, or a top-down flat lay

archetypes.name: Wordmark on the wall
archetypes.composition: soft-serif lowercase wordmark large in cream on the field, spaced-caps line above and below, the hero opposite
archetypes.elements: wordmark, 'since 1920'-style line, a small rosette or rule
archetypes.motion: letters rise out of a baseline mask 2 f apart, slowly; caps track in

archetypes.name: Flat lay
archetypes.purpose: detail and craft (opening a tin, a label close-up)
archetypes.composition: top-down on a cream or sand tile field, the object square to frame
archetypes.motion: a lid lifts and slides off; a label turns 90°

sequence.cutRhythm: almost no cuts: the wall re-tiles instead (about one re-tile per 3–6 s); a straight cut only as a printed match cut into a flat lay

scenes.action: teal wall; a cream stamp with an engraved lemon drifts in 3/4, '25' in red, 'limona · conservas · 1931' along its foot
the wall re-tiles from the top-right into brick red with a sand column; two more stamps (sand, red) fan out from under the first
the stamp's oval frame match-cuts to a tin's oval label, top-down; the lid lifts and slides off
the wall re-tiles to red; 'limona' rises letter by letter in cream, 'since 1920' tracks in above
the wall re-tiles back to teal from the bottom-left; the deck gathers; one stamp drifts home

elements.text: soft-serif lowercase wordmark rising letter by letter from a baseline mask; spaced small caps tracking in; never typed, never glitched
elements.logo: printed: on a stamp, a label or large on the wall; arrives by rising, leaves by sinking or under a re-tile
elements.icons: engraved vignettes and stamp numerals rather than icons
elements.images: printed things (stamps, labels, tins, posters) with paper fibre and soft contact shadows; engraved illustration multiplied into paper
elements.ui: avoid; if needed, printed as a label or a stamp, never a screen
elements.shapes: tiles, perforated stamps, double-rule frames, ovals, guilloche rosettes, ribbons with a repeating pattern
elements.background: the glazed tiled wall, always; it changes only by re-tiling, never by a cut

audio.sync: re-tiles start on phrase starts and their click clusters follow the strum; stamp landings on soft downbeats; long holds over sustained chords
audio.sfx: ceramic tile clicks in clusters, paper slides, stamp thuds, a tin lid, room tone; acoustic or bossa bed
